description: Integrating Geospatial Data into Electricity Access Planning with Energy Access Explorer (EAE): A Case Study of Tanzania is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Access to reliable electricity is fundamental to socioeconomic development, poverty reduction, education, healthcare, and industrialization. Although Tanzania has made significant progress in expanding electricity access through the Rural Energy Agency (REA) and Tanzania Electric Supply Company (TANESCO), many rural communities remain unelectrified due to high infrastructure costs, dispersed settlements, and difficult terrain. Coverage: Tanzania. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
